content.short: Tonkey is a specialized multisig wallet for TON, designed for secure team management of shared digital funds.
content.description: Tonkey is a dedicated multi-signature (multisig) wallet built specifically for the TON blockchain. It is designed to meet the needs of teams, DAOs, and organizations by requiring multiple approvals for any transaction, significantly reducing the risk of unauthorized access or single points of failure. Tonkey provides a professional-grade interface for managing shared treasuries, ensuring that institutional and group funds on TON are handled with the highest levels of security and governance.
content.meta: Manage team funds securely with Tonkey, the premier multisig wallet for TON. Explore on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
